Messages.Author: Screaming Vermillian
Messages.Body:
So Parmenides with fame purges, gets banished, but then I transfer him
back into play, gets passed to the right. Does the purge trigger during
my predators turn, or my own?

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:


BP doesn't have specific control text, so it's controlled by the
controller of Parmenides. The "you" refers to the controller of the
card. It burns on your predator's turn.

http://groups-beta.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/browse_frm/thread/dcdf932fbbad3d78/6680a95c2ce56ae2?q=author:LSJ+%22you+control%22#6680a95c2ce56ae2

--Colin McGuigan
